request.description: One native pixel art fantasy enemy STILL for Dungeon Matcher, full body three-quarter combat stance looking slightly viewer-left, transparent background. Crisp ONE-source-pixel #0A0D11 contours, NO antialias, gradient, dithering, grain, text, ground shadow or scenery. Broad connected 2-3-tone top-left shaded material shapes; compact whimsical expressive identity. Keep every extremity inside 2-pixel side margins. Matte charcoal/navy iron, muted leather, small brass, luminous orange ONLY in ore sockets. Powerfully BROAD rune-smith DWARF with braided BLACK beard bound by metal rings, charred dark apron over slate shirt and thick bare forearms, heavy gloves, serious face, NO helmet. Both hands grip a HUGE MECHANICAL SLEDGEHAMMER with square head, stabilizer braces and visible orange crystal socket. Distinguish from small masonry mallet: heavy tool dominates left silhouette, torso broad and strong, short planted legs. No axe, wand, flames or gold skin.
